gameDescriptionHtml:
Yao-Guai Hunter is a Wuxia roguelike deck-building game. In a world where Yao-Guai roam free, player battles with various evil beings, collecting cards and learn inner skills. Encountering various adventures in the martial world.

When spirits roam and legends come alive, only a true cultivator can restore balance.

As a lone Yao Hunter, wield blade and spell to cleanse a world where ancient demons awaken and forgotten myths take shape.

Step into a hand-painted realm inspired by Chinese folklore – a living scroll of monsters, miracles, and martial arts.

Every choice writes a legend. Every battle bends fate.

Game Features

  • 400+ Handcrafted Cards
  • 172 Inner Skills
  • 54 Mystical Elixirs
  • 100+ Random Events
  • 100+ Unique Enemies
  • 20 Ascending Difficulty Levels
  • Yao Hunt Tournament – Team up with friends and race to cleanse the land
  • Yao-Hunter’s Edict – Daily global challenges with ranked leaderboards
  • Custom Mode – Tailor your adventure with custom seeds and rules
